text:
Nina: tiny confession — i renamed a branch to `fix/yaml-indentation_-v1` and the CI thought it was a new religion. :pray:
Omar: classic. the branch-naming cult is real. what happened?
Nina: build-bot threw an error: 'could not parse version from ref: fix/yaml-indentation_-v1' and then my Slack got spammed with 12 alerts.
build-bot: Pipeline aborted: VersionParsingError: multiple separators found in ref 'fix/yaml-indentation_-v1'
Jess: that branch name contains an underscore AND a dash combo. it's basically the Bermuda Triangle of parsers.
Omar: Bonus: the last PR i reviewed had a YAML block like:
Omar: ```yaml
- name: release
	version: v1..2
  env: prod
```
Omar: two dots in semver + tab + misaligned env key. parser entered witness protection.
Nina: you ever think our codebase secretly judges us? :thinking_face:
build-bot: Suggested remediation: enforce branch pattern `^(feature|fix|chore)\/[a-z0-9\-]+$` and semver regex `^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$`. See docs: https://ci.internal/rules
Jess: can we also add a friendly bot reply: "Did you mean v1.2.0 or performance art?"
Omar: yes pls. also an optional "YAML CPR" workshop with donuts.
Nina: donuts + linting = happiness. i'll open a tiny RFC for the branch rule and a pre-commit that autoformats YAML.
Jess: emoji vote: :doughnut: for mandatory workshop or :shrug: for optional?
Nina: :doughnut: :doughnut: :doughnut:
Omar: :doughnut:
build-bot: Rule PR opened by Nina: https://ci.internal/prs/9999 — checks will run after merge.
Nina: thanks team. next time i will consult the Semver Oracle before pushing. :crystal_ball:
